scenes.location: A rooftop restaurant with a view of the city skyline
scenes.description: Violet James is out with her boyfriend, Han, and their close friends for a celebratory dinner to mark the end of her recent theater performance. The atmosphere is warm, with soft music playing in the background and a sunset casting a golden hue over the city. Han is unusually quiet and fidgety, while Violet is caught in a mix of excitement and nervousness. Her friend Yuna keeps glancing at Han, sensing something significant is about to happen.

characters.name: Violet James
characters.description: A 25-year-old drama student with a warm, emotional, and enthusiastic personality. She recently completed a successful performance and is unaware of the surprise awaiting her.; 25-year-old / Female / Drama Student, 24 years old; Occupation: Graduate Student in Drama; Personality: Emotional, Enthusiastic, Nervous; Values: Love, Commitment, Friendship; Interests: Theater, Performing arts, Celebrations; Experiences: Recent performance, Romantic relationship, Friend group
characters.position: Seated at the table, across from Han, with a glass of wine in hand

characters.name: Han Lee
characters.description: A 24-year-old aspiring filmmaker who is deeply in love with Violet; Male; Age: 24; Occupation: Film student and part-time videographer; Personality: Thoughtful, romantic, determined; Values: Commitment, creativity, authenticity; Interests: Independent cinema, storytelling, photography; Experiences: Worked on short films that never gained attention, met Violet during a college theater project, saved money for years to afford a meaningful proposal.
characters.position: Seated next to Violet, subtly adjusting the ring box in his pocket

characters.name: Yuna Kim
characters.description: Violet's best friend and fellow drama student, known for her supportive and observant nature. She has a hunch about Han's intentions and is quietly rooting for Violet to say yes; Female; Age: 22; Occupation: Theater Production Assistant; Personality: Empathetic, perceptive, loyal; Values: Friendship, authenticity, artistic expression; Interests: Playwriting, indie films, journaling; Experiences: Co-directed a student-written play, supported Violet through a difficult breakup, nearly proposed to her ex-boyfriend but backed out due to uncertainty.
characters.position: Across the table from Violet, sipping her drink and watching the exchange closely

characters.name: Ethan Cole
characters.description: A laid-back friend of both Violet and Han who is more of a background presence but adds a sense of camaraderie and humor to the group; Male; Age: 24; Occupation: Freelance graphic designer; Personality: easygoing, witty, observant; Values: friendship, creativity, authenticity; Interests: urban photography, indie music, good food; Experiences: worked on promotional art for Violet’s theater productions, traveled solo through Southeast Asia for inspiration, helped Han design a website for his small business.
characters.position: Seated at the table, engaged in a conversation with another friend
characters.states: Relaxed, cheerful, oblivious to the tension

actions.action: Han raises his glass of wine and makes a toast to Violet's performance and their time together.
actions.dialogue: To Violet, for her incredible performance and for being the most amazing person I know. You've brought so much light into my life.

actions.action: Violet smiles brightly and clinks her glass with Han's, her heart racing with a mix of joy and confusion.
actions.dialogue: Thank you, Han. I couldn't have done it without your support. You've always been there for me.

actions.action: Yuna gently nudges Violet under the table, giving her a small encouraging smile.
Han suddenly stands up, surprising everyone at the table, and takes Violet's hand.
actions.dialogue: Violet, there's something I've been meaning to ask you. You've made me believe in the future, and I want to build it with you.

actions.action: Violet's eyes widen in surprise, her cheeks flush, and she takes a deep breath, trying to compose herself.
actions.dialogue: Han, I... I didn't expect this.

actions.action: Han gets down on one knee and opens a small velvet box, revealing a simple but elegant ring.
actions.dialogue: Violet James, will you marry me?

actions.action: Violet looks at the ring, then at Han, and finally at Yuna, who gives her a thumbs-up.
actions.dialogue: I... I don't know what to say. This is so unexpected, but it's also exactly what I've been hoping for.

actions.action: Yuna wipes a tear from her eye and leans over to whisper something to Violet.
actions.dialogue: Say yes, Violet. You know you love him as much as he loves you.

actions.action: Violet takes a deep breath, then smiles through her tears and nods.
actions.dialogue: Yes, Han. I will marry you.

actions.action: Ethan claps enthusiastically and raises his glass, cheering for the couple.
actions.dialogue: To the future! That's the best kind of ending to a performance, don't you think?

scenes.plot: Han proposes to Violet during a celebratory dinner for her recent theater performance, catching her off guard but also revealing the depth of their relationship. Violet, despite her initial hesitation, accepts, marking the beginning of a new chapter in their lives. Yuna supports Violet throughout the moment, subtly guiding her toward a decision, while their friends celebrate the happy occasion.
scenes.social_purpose: To showcase Violet's emotional and enthusiastic nature, her commitment to love, and the importance of friendship and shared experiences in a public setting.

chunk.text: Violet's heart is full of anticipation and uncertainty as she is caught in the emotional moment of a proposal. Her friends support her, and she must make a decision that will define her future in a relationship.
